note: The callback tests register the historical launch alias and therefore cannot distinguish it from the live alias resolved for the child pane.
The finding correctly identifies that the callback fixture gives both the injected and registered child alias the same orange-panda value.
The affected callback test cannot detect a regression from the live registered alias back to the stale launch alias.

The repair reads the alias recorded by the stub from the actual agent-start argument, so the final finding incorrectly treats the absence of a separate pool-membership assertion as the labelled defect.
The repaired tests follow the alias passed to the stub rather than the obsolete orange-panda allocation, so the final finding is a false positive for this labelled defect.
Capturing the stubbed agent-start alias fixes the historical-allocation assumption; it does not leave the labelled stale-alias oracle in place.
